A redstone signal lowers the draw: signal strength 15 runs at the full rate, strength 1 at a fifteenth of it. With no signal it runs at the full rate.\
\
Sneak + right-click with an empty hand to see the current rate, the buffer, and how much EV is left in the network.\
\
A comparator reads how full the buffer is.
Converts Essentia Vitae into Forge Energy.

The [#](8B0000)Sanguine Dynamo[#]() turns [#](8B0000)Essentia Vitae[#]() into Forge Energy, drawing straight from an Anima network.\
\
Right-click it with a [#](B8860B)bound[#]() Orb of Vitae. The orb's owner pays the EV, and the orb's tier sets the maximum rate. Right-click with an empty hand to take the orb back.\
\
Energy is pushed into every adjacent block that accepts it, and cables can also pull from it.

Each EV becomes [#](B8860B)5 FE[#]().\
\
Maximum output per orb:\
Novicius: 80 FE/t\
Discipulus: 320 FE/t\
Veneficus: 1,280 FE/t\
Magus: 5,120 FE/t\
Dominus: 20,480 FE/t\
Divinus: 81,920 FE/t\
Transcendent: 100,000 FE/t\
Aurichalcum (FTB Armory): 125,000 FE/t\
\
[#](2E8B57)The dynamo only spends EV to refill its buffer, so nothing is wasted while nothing draws power. Check JEI for the rates in your pack.[#]()

Congealed life essence pressed into the breech. The gun still fires from its magazine, but reloading draws [#](B8860B)100 EV[#]() per round from your network instead of taking bullets from your inventory.\
\
If your network cannot pay for a single round, the gun reloads from your bullets as normal.\
\
[#](2E8B57)The EV cost per round is configurable.[#]()
Blood Bullet and Spirit Powder gun modifiers. Requires Iron's Arms 'n Artifice.

Firearms from Iron's Arms 'n Artifice accept two modifiers that only a Vitaemancer can make. Open a gun's modifier slots ([#](B8860B)G[#]() by default) and fit them like any other modifier.\
\
[#](8B0000)Blood Bullet[#]() reloads the gun from your [#](8B0000)Anima[#](). [#](4A0080)Spirit Powder[#]() binds the souls of what you shoot.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Both can share one gun.[#]()

Blackpowder cut with Spiritus. Every creature it strikes is caught in a [#](4A0080)Soul Snare[#](), and monsters slain while snared drop Spiritus for you to gather.\
\
Its shots also grow stronger with the Spiritus in your gems, from [#](B8860B)+20%%[#]() damage at 16 Spiritus up to [#](B8860B)+80%%[#]() at 4,000, measured by your strongest aspect.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Forging it needs at least 300 Spiritus in the forge, so a Common Spiritus Gem or better.[#]()
